section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority

propositions.proposition: 反洗钱管理局直接监管最多40家高风险金融机构，确保其遵守单一规则手册，进行现场检查，施加纠正措施，并在适当时或涉及严重、反复、系统性违规时施加处罚。
source_quotes: Directly supervise up to 40 high-risk financial institutions. The AML Authority ensures the selected entities comply with the Single Rulebook. The AML Authority conducts onsite inspections and imposes corrective measures for remediating deficiencies. Additionally, this authority imposes penalties if appropriate or in all cases involving serious, repeated, or systematic breaches.

trigger_or_context: 高风险金融机构被选定
basis_or_condition: 如果适当，或涉及严重、反复、系统性违规

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选承接了管理局的直接监管职责，该职责涉及确保金融机构遵守单一规则手册，但未承接制定并更新该手册这一独立功能。制定规则手册是独立于直接监管的立法性职责，原文明确列为管理局首要授权。
